Settings

It checks automatically at most once every 7 days, only when you open the app, and you can check by hand at any time. An update is installed only after checking that it is newer, that its fingerprint (SHA-256) matches the one published with it and that it is signed with this app\'s own key, and then only when you confirm on Android\'s screen. GitHub sees your IP address, as with any website.
